title: Command to drive out the inhabitants of Canaan
description: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho, the Lord spoke to Moses and commanded the Israelites to drive out all the inhabitants of the land when they entered Canaan. They were to destroy carved stones, cast idols, and sacrificial mounds, and distribute the land by casting lots according to the size of each tribe. If they allowed the inhabitants to remain, these would become thorns in their eyes and barbs in their sides, and the Lord would do to Israel what He had planned to do to them.
